purpose gap: Covered: the composed USER/p8testuser.sh (owner, mode, header, policy lines); on an agent run with the session up the runner runs the script as the user and the policies themselves run (policy 1 logs 'as p8testuser'); no policy line before the logind session. GAP, lab-exercisable: the outcome 'at the user's desktop log-in, the autostart entry runs the policies' is mapped only to autostart-runs-the-policies-at-login, which matches the runner's 'Executing' line (logged BEFORE the script is called, runner line 12). Whether the script then passes its own who-check (header lines 9-14) and runs the policies at login is not tested: if who did not list the user at autostart time, the script would log 'not loged in' and exit 0, and every check would still pass, because 'after the session: some' in no-policy-runs-before-the-session is satisfied by the two session agent runs' policy lines alone. The lab can observe it: on this run the node journal shows linuxint-policies-autostart 'Executing' at 1795225621.96, then 'User p8testuser loged in, executing policies' and both p8testpolicy lines at 1795225622.3-622.5, before the first session agent run (1795225648.38); a probe tying the policy lines to the autostart (e.g. policy lines between the logind session start and the first linuxint-policies-puppet-agent line) would cover it. The uncovered row (other users/policy lists; one params fixture per set) is honest.
